sources.excerpt: Motor Honey Superdrive – Stomp Under Foot Skip to content Search Search Cart PRODUCTS CONTACT FAQ DEALERS ARTISTS ABOUT BLOG Skip to product information Previous Next Close MOTOR HONEY SUPERDRIVE™ Regular price $289.99 By Stomp Under Foot Quantity COMING SOON The Motor Honey Superdrive is a preamp overdrive/distortion pedal developed over many years of tweaking and modifying circuits to create a true all-around pedal. It features two circuits in one, allowing you to tailor each side to work together or independently, depending on your needs. Each circuit is designed so that, when used together, they cascade into each other without altering your overall tone. I’m known for fuzz, and that is exactly why this pedal is different. This wasn’t about making another overdrive, it was about creating something that feels and responds like part of your amp. Whether you are running clean or pushing it into breakup, the Motor Honey blends in naturally, delivering everything from low-gain grit to fat, juicy distortion. It is dynamic, touch-sensitive, and retains the character and tone of your guitar. It works just as well with single-coils as it does with humbuckers, keeping your core tone intact while adding the right amount of gain and saturation. Features: True-Bypass NOS Through-Hole Components 9V Battery or 2.1 9V Adapter Only Handmade in the USA View details MOTOR HONEY SUPERDRIVE™ Close STOMP UNDER FOOT Handmade one at a time in the USA.
